verdict.rationale: Bitbucket's own product page says IP allowlisting restricts code access to authorized users, so the capability exists first-party. The only support is a repeated one-line marketing claim with no configuration documentation or corroboration. Missing for 10: documentation of how allowlists are configured and at what scope (workspace or organization), which plan tiers include it, whether it covers Git/SSH/API access as well as the web UI, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can restrict access to organization code to an IP allowlist

citations.quote: 2FA and IP allowlisting keep your code accessible only by authorized users.
2FA and IP allowlisting keep your code accessible only by authorized users. All code is encrypted in transit and at rest.
